title: Cáritas Nuevo Laredo collects more than 34 tons of food for vulnerable families
excerpt: Cáritas Nuevo Laredo reports more than 34 tons of food collected in its annual 'Alimenta' campaign, aiding more than 700 families — over 6,000 people — with donations open through November 15.
content:
Cáritas Nuevo Laredo reports collecting more than 34 tons of food through its annual campaign "Alimenta, Multipliquemos el Milagro por un México sin Hambre," aid destined for vulnerable families and institutions in the municipality, according to Central de Noticias Tamaulipas.

The organization's board president, Father Rogelio Lozano Alcorta, said the donations collected so far allow direct assistance to more than 700 family units, a projected benefit for more than 6,000 people on a regular basis.

Since the campaign days began October 17, schools, residents and local businesses have contributed 23 tons and 177.5 kilograms of food directly, with the remainder coming through the campaign's wider collection effort, according to the report.

The organization's director, Elda Elizondo de Ramos, confirmed that receipt of non-perishable food will remain open at its central facilities and authorized collection points through November 15, with schools, businesses and residents invited to keep contributing.

Sources:

  • Central de Noticias Tamaulipas, "Cáritas Nuevo Laredo recauda más de 34 toneladas de víveres en apoyo a familias vulnerables," October 30, 2026
